book2.description: A 34-second explainer of "Training and the Turn to RL": Behavior is trained in, not prompted in. Includes Alessandro Cappelli (Adaptive ML)'s quote, source-anchored to the claims ledger.
A 34-second explainer of "Inference Economics": Inference is a recurring cost you pay on every request. Includes Kyle Kranen (NVIDIA)'s quote, source-anchored to the claims ledger.
A 34-second explainer of "Building Frontier Models": Stagnation is a training-budget story, not a ceiling. Includes Raia Hadsell (DeepMind)'s quote, source-anchored to the claims ledger.
A 34-second explainer of "Beyond Text": Model-building is one discipline, whatever the model outputs. Includes Samuel Humeau (Mistral)'s quote, source-anchored to the claims ledger.
A 34-second explainer of "Robotics and the Physical World": The bug is the system, not the policy. Includes Cormac Brick (Google)'s quote, source-anchored to the claims ledger.
A 34-second explainer of "Regulated and High-Stakes Domains": Not the technique, but the standard. Includes Anterior's quote, source-anchored to the claims ledger.
A 34-second explainer of "Creative, Education, and Games": The system owns the truth, the model owns the words. Includes Quoraishee & Song (NYT)'s quote, source-anchored to the claims ledger.
A 34-second explainer of "What the Edges Teach": The frontier consolidates. The lanes stay drawn. Includes Reed & Revere (SonderMind)'s quote, source-anchored to the claims ledger.

book3.description: A 34-second explainer of "The Bottleneck Moved": Code generation was never the bottleneck. Includes Gabriel Spencer-Harper (Meticulous)'s quote, source-anchored to the claims ledger.
A 34-second explainer of "Intent Before Specification": A specification is an answer. Includes Kent C. Dodds (EpicProduct.engineer)'s quote, source-anchored to the claims ledger.
A 34-second explainer of "What a Specification Is For": It is an alignment device before it is an input. Includes Sean Grove (OpenAI)'s quote, source-anchored to the claims ledger.
A 34-second explainer of "Decomposition and the Plan": Planning is compression of intent. Includes Dex Horthy (HumanLayer)'s quote, source-anchored to the claims ledger.
A 34-second explainer of "Execution Under a Spec": Permissions are specification, enforced. Includes Rustin Banks (Google)'s quote, source-anchored to the claims ledger.
A 34-second explainer of "The Independence Problem": Make the check fail on purpose. Includes Tariq Shaukat (Sonar)'s quote, source-anchored to the claims ledger.
A 34-second explainer of "Gates That Can Actually Fail": A check never seen to fail is a hypothesis. Includes Sumaiya Shrabony's quote, source-anchored to the claims ledger.

A 34-second explainer of "Shipping, and the Gap Between Merged and Live": What, specifically, tells you a change is live? Includes Harald Kirschner (VS Code)'s quote, source-anchored to the claims ledger.
A 34-second explainer of "Brownfield and Spec Rot": A generated map is wrong only until the next run. Includes Denys Linkov (Wisedocs)'s quote, source-anchored to the claims ledger.
A 34-second explainer of "The Review Wall": Slop is what happens when generation outruns judgment. Includes Tariq Shaukat (Sonar)'s quote, source-anchored to the claims ledger.
A 34-second explainer of "The Factory and Its Discontents": Harness engineering is not enough. Includes Dex Horthy (HumanLayer)'s quote, source-anchored to the claims ledger.

A 34-second explainer of "How Much Process, and How Far Out of the Loop": From can I trust it to what am I giving up by not looking. Includes Geoffrey Litt (Notion)'s quote, source-anchored to the claims ledger.
